title: Conversations, Pipeline, Tasks, Leads, Doors and Shared open inside the Frequency Space console (Contacts phase 3)
detail: Contacts phase 3, parked 2026-10-14, active 2026-10-19. Plan in SCAN-872's detail. PREMISE RE-TESTED 2026-10-20: all six already open inside the Frequency Space console. crm/layout.tsx mounts FrequencySpaceConsole, and Conversations, Doors, Leads, Shared and the Pipeline view (which holds Tasks) render through ConsoleDashboardTemplate or ConsoleFocusTemplate, which hand over to AdminPageFrame under SITE_DESIGN=frequency (ADR-1740): kit head, KPI row, kit tables and glass cards. No page leaves the console. The only thing a separate body per page would add is a hand-drawn layout with no template to match; the Contacts workspace (LIVE-936) is the one place the old CRM look still shows, so the design work lives there.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/';const bad=[];if(!/FrequencySpaceConsole/.test(fs.readFileSync(d+'layout.tsx','utf8')))bad.push('layout');for(const f of ['page','conversations/page','doors/page','leads/page','shared/page']){if(!/Console(Dashboard|Focus)Template/.test(fs.readFileSync(d+f+'.tsx','utf8')))bad.push(f)}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-937: not in the console frame: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
